app_description: Capability-based action infrastructure enabling conversational AI agents to discover providers, calculate verified quotes, execute confirmed actions, and track fulfillment in real time.

find_providers.read_only_justification: This tool only searches and filters registered capability providers by category, capability flags, geography, or keyword queries without altering state.
find_providers.open_world_justification: This tool is an internal query against platform registry metadata and does not interact with open external networks.
find_providers.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero state mutations.

list_providers.read_only_justification: This tool only queries and lists registered active capability providers from the platform database without altering state or creating records.
list_providers.open_world_justification: This tool is an internal lookup against platform registry metadata and does not interact with open external networks.
list_providers.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and causes zero destructive changes or state mutations.

get_provider.read_only_justification: This tool queries detailed metadata, operational status, and capability flags for a specific provider without making any state modifications.
get_provider.open_world_justification: This tool executes an internal query against cached provider configuration records and does not perform external write actions.
get_provider.destructive_justification: This tool is strictly read-only and does not delete, overwrite, or mutate any provider data.

get_provider_capabilities.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves the array of supported capability flags for a given provider without performing any mutations.
get_provider_capabilities.open_world_justification: This tool executes an internal lookup on registered capabilities.

get_locations.read_only_justification: This tool queries geographic locations, branch facilities, and operating schedules for a provider without modifying location records.
get_locations.open_world_justification: This tool queries platform-registered facility data.

get_catalog.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves structured categories, offerings, base prices, and option groups for a provider without changing catalog data.
get_catalog.open_world_justification: This tool performs read queries against provider catalog endpoints or local cache.

search_catalog.read_only_justification: This tool executes keyword search queries across catalog items and offerings without modifying any records.
search_catalog.open_world_justification: This tool performs read-only search operations against catalog indexes.

get_offering.read_only_justification: This tool looks up specific offering details, variants, and option group rules without altering offering state.
get_offering.open_world_justification: This tool retrieves item definitions from catalog storage.

request_quote.read_only_justification: This tool calculates verified real-time pricing, item breakdown, add-on costs, and fulfillment fees. It is a calculation pre-requisite before any action execution and does not create an active commitment.
request_quote.open_world_justification: This tool executes pricing calculations through provider adapters without committing orders.
request_quote.destructive_justification: This tool produces temporary quote estimates and causes no destructive effects.

create_action.read_only_justification: This tool creates an active transaction and dispatches the action to the external provider. It is an intentional write action.
create_action.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with external provider systems to register the action and generate a provider-supplied payment link.
create_action.destructive_justification: This tool does not delete user data. It creates a new action record with verified pricing and idempotency protections.

get_action.read_only_justification: This tool queries current status, tracking events, and fulfillment updates for an existing action without changing its state.
get_action.open_world_justification: This tool performs status lookup against provider status endpoints.

cancel_action.read_only_justification: This tool updates an eligible active action to CANCELLED state and notifies the provider adapter.
cancel_action.open_world_justification: This tool communicates with external provider systems to release reservations and cancel ongoing processing.
cancel_action.destructive_justification: This tool changes action status to CANCELLED and initiates settlement adjustments where applicable.

get_payment_options.read_only_justification: This tool retrieves provider-supplied HTTPS checkout URLs and payment method instructions without handling sensitive payment data or mutating balances.
get_payment_options.open_world_justification: This tool queries external provider checkout endpoint metadata.
